_note: Pilot events that passed the DATA-03 FIRMS + AirNow check on 2026-10-06 (7 of the 20 in docs/pilot-events.md). Each bbox is centred on the event's FRP-weighted FIRMS _SP cluster, because PurpleAir distance-ranking uses the bbox centre as a proxy for the fire. Borderline and failed events, with reasons, are listed under Data-availability verification in docs/pilot-events.md and are deliberately not included here. Peak PM2.5 / tier confirmation from AQS is still pending for every event.

events.name: August Complex Fire
events.region: Northern California (Trinity, Tehama, Glenn, Lake, Mendocino counties)
events.bbox_note: Centred on the FRP-weighted centroid of the event's FIRMS _SP cluster (39.929, -122.995): the cluster's FRP-weighted 98th-percentile extent plus a 25 km buffer, symmetric about the centroid. 148 x 148 km.
